limits.source: Google AI Studio rate-limits page for this project, checked 2026-09-29: 15 RPM, 250K TPM, 500 RPD. The client stays one request and 10K tokens under the per-minute caps. Free-tier limits are not guaranteed by Google; if they change, edit these numbers.

pricing.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (paid tier, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite), checked 2026-09-29. Thinking tokens are billed as output. Used only to estimate cost: the project runs on the free tier.

v2.reason: Not decided yet. Set after the v1 failure analysis (PDF 7.5): change exactly one setting, aimed at the failure category with the most failures.

notes.temperature: Kept at 1.0 because Google strongly recommends the default for Gemini 3 models (lower values can cause looping). Answers can therefore differ between runs of the same question.
notes.baseline: The baseline run uses the v1 prompt rules and generation settings, with every source pasted into the prompt and no retrieval or tools.
notes.control: The control run sends the question exactly as asked: no system prompt, no sources, no tools.
